description: Stock aerodynamics. Drag cubes are the stock PartDatabase.cfg cubes loaded by DragCubeList.LoadCubes and evaluated by the real DragCubeList.SetDragWeights / SetPartOcclusion (part without attachments) / SetDrag. 'flow_dir' is the air-relative velocity direction in part-local coordinates (Unity left-handed, +Y = part up); SetDrag is called with -flow_dir exactly as FlightIntegrator.UpdateAerodynamics passes dragVectorDirLocal. Drag/lift force scalars use the real FlightIntegrator.CalculateDragValue and the re-hosted scalar statements of UpdateAerodynamics (FlightIntegrator.cs:2353-2370). Lifting surfaces use the real ModuleLiftingSurface.GetLiftVector / GetDragVector with SetupCoefficients' vector arithmetic re-hosted (it reads a Transform).

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono

tables.name: drag_curve_value
tables.description: PhysicsGlobals.DragCurveValue(SurfaceCurves, dotNormalized, mach) - per-face drag multiplier; dotNormalized = (dot(flow, faceNormal)+1)/2.

tables.name: cube_inputs
tables.description: Drag cube definitions used (raw 'cube' strings from PartDatabase.cfg) and the weights applied.

tables.name: cube_drag
tables.description: DragCubeList.SetDrag(-flow_dir, mach) outputs plus FlightIntegrator drag value.

tables.name: drag_chain_kerbin
tables.description: Kerbin flight condition -> FlightIntegrator atmosphere state -> SetDrag -> UpdateAerodynamics force scalars (flow along part +Y unless noted, part.bodyLiftMultiplier = 1, not submerged).

tables.name: lifting_surface
tables.description: ModuleLiftingSurface.GetLiftVector/GetDragVector (real) for the stock 'Default' curve set. Wing normal (liftVector) = +Z part-local; flow in the Y-Z plane at angle of attack aoa; omnidirectional; Q in Pa.
